cases.claim: a union of two coaxial cylinders whose top caps are coplanar (a 0.6 bore and a 1.05 socket ending together at z = 6.3, the stepped bore of a pipe fitting) commits with the stepped solid's exact volume pi*(0.36*15.6 + 1.1025*3.3 - 0.36*3.3) = 25.3408717; OCCT's fuse of the same operands gives 25.3408715 and reads the export back valid. On r1n and earlier it was refused with K1 reason 92: the caps sit at -9.3 + 15.6 = 6.299999999999999 and 3 + 3.3 = 6.3, one ulp apart, so the exact coplanar test found no pair while the classifier, within its tolerance band, placed each cap on the other solid

the G6 impeller hub (a 23-segment revolve with a 0.5 mm rim beyond the blade tip radius) united with one skinned blade commits in seconds with a certified volume that contains OCCT's fuse 445434.0324 mm3; r1o refused it after validation (face-face-uncertain on two coaxial back-face cones meeting at under 1 degree), and before the rim fix the flush blade trailing face was tangent to the hub's rim circle (K1 reason 81) and the refusal took over 30 minutes

the G6 impeller hub united with one blade and one splitter 15 degrees off the hub's seam commits with a certified volume that contains OCCT's fuse of the same operands, 447471.2819 mm3; on r1p it was refused with K1 reason 93 because the plane-cone tracer seeded a 30-degree theta grid over the full circle and never seeded the splitter trailing face's 1.6-degree cut through the last hub cone

the G6 CMC stator monolith, inner and outer rings united with 29 skinned NGVs, commits with a certified volume containing 458671.40 + 29 x 909.676 = 485051.99 mm3 (each single-NGV union is OCCT-checked at 459581.0774); r1k ran 59 min and rejected it (edge-face-uncertain), r1t committed it 1500 mm3 high because six NGV angles sampled a trimmed Bezier edge one ulp past its domain and evaluated the origin

the union of a revolved diffuser plate with one skinned straightener vane whose root is embedded 1 mm inside the plate wall and whose ruled side faces cross the r = 47 cylinder transversally commits with a certified volume that contains OCCT's fuse of the same operands (30424.53243 mm3); r1k and p7d refused it with K1 reason 72: the patch-cylinder tracer reached the patch edge and its fixed step landed on the extrapolated patch, where Newton cannot converge, so the trace was abandoned instead of retried with a shorter step

the G6 stator's inner and outer CMC rings united with one skinned NGV commit with a certified volume that contains OCCT's fuse of the same operands, 459581.0774 mm3; r1p certified [459629.2165, 459629.2217], 48 mm3 too high, because the planar end caps' trimmed Bezier edges were integrated over their whole curve instead of their edge domain
